# edgecdn.ru
> EdgeCDN provides CDN, DDoS protection, DNS hosting, WAF, object storage, and related edge infrastructure services.

The site focuses on edge delivery and security products for websites, applications, and media, with product pages, pricing, blog content, and customer account access.

## Core Products
- [CDN](https://edgecdn.ru/cdn/): Content delivery network service for accelerating websites, APIs, and static assets.
- [Video CDN](https://edgecdn.ru/video/): Media delivery platform for streaming and distributing video content efficiently.
- [DDoS Protection](https://edgecdn.ru/ddos/): Network and application-layer protection against distributed denial-of-service attacks.
- [WAF](https://edgecdn.ru/waf/): Web application firewall for filtering malicious traffic and protecting web applications.
- [DNS Hosting](https://edgecdn.ru/dns/): Managed authoritative DNS service for domain resolution and traffic control.
- [Object Storage](https://edgecdn.ru/storage/): S3-compatible storage for files, backups, and content distribution workflows.
- [Load Balancer](https://edgecdn.ru/load-balancer/): Traffic distribution service for improving availability and application resilience.

## Security Services
- [DDoS Protection](https://edgecdn.ru/ddos/): Protects online services from volumetric and protocol-based attacks.
- [WAF](https://edgecdn.ru/waf/): Shields websites and APIs from common web exploits and malicious requests.
- [SSL Certificates](https://edgecdn.ru/ssl/): TLS certificate services for securing websites and encrypted connections.
- [DNS Hosting](https://edgecdn.ru/dns/): DNS infrastructure supporting reliable domain resolution and traffic management.

## Storage and Media
- [Object Storage](https://edgecdn.ru/storage/): Cloud storage for static assets, backups, and origin content.
- [Video CDN](https://edgecdn.ru/video/): Video acceleration and delivery for streaming and media-heavy applications.
- [CDN](https://edgecdn.ru/cdn/): Edge caching layer for distributing static and dynamic content globally.

- [DNS Pricing](https://edgecdn.ru/dns/price/): Rates and plan details for managed DNS hosting.
- [Object Storage Pricing](https://edgecdn.ru/storage/price/): Pricing for storage capacity, requests, and data transfer.

## Solutions and Use Cases
- [For Online Stores](https://edgecdn.ru/ecommerce/): Edge and security services tailored for e-commerce performance and protection.
- [For Media Projects](https://edgecdn.ru/media/): Delivery and infrastructure solutions for content-rich and streaming platforms.
- [For Corporate Websites](https://edgecdn.ru/corporate/): Performance and security services for business web properties.
- [For Gaming Projects](https://edgecdn.ru/gaming/): Infrastructure support for latency-sensitive gaming and interactive services.
